column1: # The Arduino ESP32 core picks this up automatically because it sits next to
# the sketch — no "Partition Scheme" menu setting required
# wrong one to be selected by accident.
# Layout is the standard "Huge APP" arrangement for a 4MB module: a single 3MB
# app slot instead of two 1.9MB OTA slots. BLE plus GPS plus the magnetometer
# comfortably exceeds what the default two-slot layout allows
# flashed over USB rather than over the air
column2: so the second slot is wasted space.
